paper_metadata.title: Excellent mechanical properties of CoNiCr-based MP159 multicomponent alloys at ambient and cryogenic temperatures

evidence.quote: The commercial CoNiCr-based MP159 superalloy with high configuration entropy up to that of HEAs is revisited.
In this study, the evolution of coherent precipitates at different aging time in MP159 alloys was investigated.

The original ingots of MP159 alloys were homogenized at 1150 ◦ C for 2 h. Then, the homogenized specimens were cold rolled with a total thickness reduction of ~60% (the thickness changed from 3 to 1.2 mm), subsequently recrystallized at 950 ◦ C for 15 min. At last, the recrystallized samples aged at 650 ◦ C for 0 (Un-aged), 1, 5, 10, and 20 h, respectively (denoted as CRRA0, CRRA1, CRRA5, CRRA10 and CRRA20, respectively).
